items.head: Caution
items.quote: The following areas in the South Shetland Islands, into which entry is prohibited without a permit, have been established by the Convention on the Conservation of Antarctic Marine Living Resources (CCAMLR): 1. Stinker Point, Elephant Island (61°08'S., 55°21'W.). 2. Cape Shireff and Telmo Island (62°27'S., 60°47'W.)— also requires a Management Plan prior to entry. 3.
